example_sentences_in_bangla: সে বাঘের মাসির মতো নির্ভীকভাবে জঙ্গলে ঢুকল।
যুদ্ধক্ষেত্রে সৈনিকরা বাঘের মাসির মতো ভয় পেল না।
example_sentences_in_english: He entered the jungle as fearlessly as a tiger's aunt.
The soldiers showed no fear in the battlefield, like a tiger's aunt.
history: This idiom draws from Bengali rural folklore where tigers symbolize ultimate power and danger; the 'aunt' implies a familial tie that commands even greater respect and fearlessness in local storytelling traditions.
note: The idiom evokes imagery of untouchable boldness in tiger-dominated wilderness areas of Bengal.
